quandoUsar: Choosing one of a few fixed colors: a product finish, the color of a label or a project.
When some color may be unavailable: `disabled` on the option shows it struck through, and the keyboard skips over it.
In forms: `name` adds a hidden field with the chosen value.
quandoEvitar: Use `color-picker` when the person needs any color, with hue, opacity, or a typed value.
Use `radio-cards` when each option needs visible text, price, or description; here the color name only appears in the mouse tooltip and for the screen reader.
To check several colors at the same time: it is a radio group, so only one is chosen.

teclado.acao: Chooses the next enabled color; from the last it wraps to the first.
Chooses the previous enabled color; from the first it goes to the last.
Chooses the first or last enabled color.
Chooses the focused color, when it is not already the chosen one.
Enters the group at the chosen color, or at the first enabled one when nothing has been chosen.

acessibilidade: The group is a `role="radiogroup"` named by `label` (required) and each color is a `role="radio"` button with `aria-checked` and a roving tabindex.
Give each option a `label`: it is the name read by the screen reader and the mouse tooltip; without it, what is heard is the `value`.
The choice is marked by an outer ring and the unavailable color by a strike, so neither state depends on color alone.
movimento: A single ring slides from one color to another with a gentle spring, instead of vanishing from one and appearing on the other.
The swatch grows slightly under the cursor and sinks when pressed.
With “reduce motion” on, the ring changes place instantly and swatches do not change scale.
responsivo: Swatches wrap (`flex-wrap`) and measure 24, 32, or 40 px depending on `size` (`sm`, `md`, `lg`).
notasIA: `options` is `{ value, color, label?, disabled? }[]`, and `color` accepts any CSS color, including tokens like `var(--tone-teal)`.
Controlled with `value` + `onValueChange` or uncontrolled with `defaultValue`; the group's `label` is required and does not show on screen.
Since the color name is not visible, show the choice as text alongside, as the demo does with “Finish: Moss”; `shape` toggles between `circle` and `rounded`.
